lines.en: I dream of something peculiar.
A sea of flowers sprawls out across a graveyard on the far reaches of a familiar place under a less than familiar sky.
As I walk toward the horizon, I notice tangled vines emerging from the ground and wrapping around various tombstones, untouched by humans for quite some time.
Though the same can not be said for the touch of time.
Edges of graves that may have once been sharp have been eroded by the weather and its incessant desire to switch from summer to winter in the blink of an eye.
I stop walking for some reason after reaching a grave much larger than the rest.
I can not make out the names on it, but it feels as if someone very important to me is buried here.
Or was buried here.
I think the important parts of human remains tend to disappear over time, feeding the soil and allowing things like vines to sprawl out as far as the eye can see.
I thank the remains for their wonderful contribution to painting this wasteland a plethora of beautiful colors.
And then I leave.
: Sensei...wake up...
: Good morning, Sensei...
: Or, should I say...onii-chan?
: I mean...you can call me whatever you want I guess. But that doesn’t explain why you’re waking me up at...
: What time even is it right now?
: It’s only 7:00.
: I know you like to sleep later normally, but certain...circumstances meant that I had to wake you up a little earlier than normal.
: But, to make up for it, I cooked you breakfast and brewed you coffee! Isn’t that sweet of me, onii-chan?
: This is weird.
: What’s weird about taking care of my big brother?
: Probably the fact that I am suddenly your big brother and not your [uncle].
: It’s part of the contest...
: I have to compete with Noriko to show her that I’m the only person fit to take care of you...
: And I know it probably sounds a little weird since you’ve always looked at me as a [niece], but...I’m kind of like a little sister too, right?
: Like we could completely change roles and it wouldn’t be any different at all.
: Yeah, if that’s the whole point of the contest, you kind of do have the upper hand.
: Right! Which is why I’m sure you’ll pick me no matter what I do.
: Lucky for you, all I want to do is take care of you and make you happy, so doing stuff like bringing you breakfast in bed is no trouble at all.
: Now go ahead and eat up! We have lots to do today, onii-chan.
: And maybe...lots to do tonight as well?...
: Ooooh! A secret, suggestive attack this early in the contest?! Ami truly is a force to be reckoned with!
: Oh. I guess you two are here as well.
: This totally isn’t weird or anything.
: You do remember that you two are actually related, right?...
: If it’s with onii-chan...I don’t care~
: Don’t mind us, Sensei! Just takin’ notes and makin’ sure nothing weird happens!
: Just feel free livin’ up the fantasy until it’s time for Noriko’s turn.
: Noriko?! Is it my turn?! I’m ready whenever!
: Stay out there, demon! I’ve barely had any time at all!
: Ughhhhh fine! But only because I love you!
I lean up in bed and slide further away from Uta and Makoto, who have more than likely been taking notes on...how I sleep or something.
I don’t really know what they were doing before Ami woke me up, but I’m not really in any rush to find out.
Unless it was something sexual. Then I’d want to find out right away.
But it probably wasn’t so...nevermind, I guess.
I quickly eat the breakfast Ami made for me and finish it off with coffee.
Just as always, it was exactly to my liking. But at this point, I don’t really expect anything less of her.
In fact, if she ever made anything that wasn’t exactly to my liking, I’d take it as a sign of an emergency and quickly rush her to the hospital to make sure she isn’t dying.
Thankfully, she is not dying today.
Instead, she’s just clinging to my arm while two of her classmates look on and take notes.
Yup, it’s a completely normal morning.
: You know, onii-chan...it isn’t often that we get to be as close as this in front of others...
: Would you believe me if I told you I was feeling a little...embarrassed?
: I wouldn’t. I bet you’re loving this right now.
: Hehehe~
: You’re right...
: I love my big brother more than anything else in the whole wide world. And I don’t care who knows it.
: So feel free to wrap your arms around me and pull me close if you want!
: Or just let me cling to you like this.
: So is this really all this competition is?
: Mmm...I think so?
: We didn’t really come up with any rules. I’m just supposed to prove that I’m the ideal sister.
: And I know you like time to wake up in the morning, so I can’t really do anything exciting.
: I’ll just sit here with you and be cute and expect you to make the right choice.
: It’s not like I mind or anything, but...
: But what?
: You want me to go the extra mile for you?
: Objection, that’s-
: Shh! I wanna see what this “extra mile” is!
: Hey! Isn’t that long enough?
: How am I supposed to compete if Ami’s going to take up like a whole hour in there?
: Hmm...it is getting close to the ten minutes we allotted her.
: That’s right...Letting Ami go any longer would mean we’d have to let Noriko do the same.
: And the rest of the girls should already be heading to the park for the next contest right now.
: Onii-chan...they’re trying to take me away from you...
: It’s just like at the orphanage...where that mean family wanted to adopt me and use me for all sorts of gross things...but you stepped in and saved me...
: What?
: Then...as soon as we became old enough...we went out on our own...
: And then...after falling asleep in each other’s arms in that cold, broken down house...we realized that we were no normal brother and sister-
: Okay, I’ve waited long enough.
: Tell Ami to step down before she gets any further into her backstory or I’ll basically lose before I even have a chance.
: Good point, Noriko.
: I’ve gotta say, as soon as she broke out the orphan thing, even I started to get won over, and I’m not even on her team.
: I didn’t even get to the part with the graveyard yet.
: You are absolutely disgusting.
: Noriko, please step in before this competition gets any more...[incest]uous.
: I mean, gladly. But isn’t the whole competition conceptually [incest]uous?
: Yes...but you and Sensei aren’t actually related.
: Makoto is desensitized to fake [incest] thanks to all of the porn she watches with her mom and-
: I have never once watched anything like that with my mother!
: Whatever you say, Makoto.
: Ami! Please leave the room now!
: You already have the advantage in that you got to be the one to wake Sensei up. So Noriko already has to figure out a way to overcome that handicap and-
: Oh, you don’t have to worry about that.
: What do you mean? Do you already have a plan on how to counter that?
: Yup! And if Sensei drank all of his coffee, then my counter attack should be kicking in any second now.
: I’m sorry, what?
: Did...
: Did you drug my [uncle]?!
: No, I drugged your onii-chan.
: Mwahahaha! The second floor wastes no time in showing everyone how dangerous it can be!
: I feel kind of dizzy all of a sudden...
: Ahh! Sensei! Hang on!
: What in the world have you done, Noriko?!
: I just told you what I did.
: If there was a “don’t drug your teacher rule,” I would have gladly followed it. I’m just countering in the only way I could think of.
: I...uhhh...
: He’ll only be out for a couple minutes anyway. And by the time he wakes up, you’ll all be able to see how a real little sister treats her big bro.
: This is entirely unacceptable! If that’s how the second floor girls are going to compete, this entire competition is-
: Yeah, yeah, yeah. If Sensei thinks it’s so bad, he’ll just pick Ami instead. What’s the big deal?
: Ami, be a good girl and wait in the living room like Noriko waited for you.
: She only waited because she knew he’d pass out after drinking his coffee!
: Onii-chan...wake up...
: Onii-chan...
: Onii-chan...onii-chan...onii-chan...
: Good morning~
: Noriko?...
: Did...you actually drug me?
: I have no idea what you’re talking about, onii-chan.
: You were mumbling in your sleep, so I came in to make sure everything was okay.
: I was probably mumbling because I was drugged.
: Are you sure you weren’t just having a perverted dream about your little sister?...
: You’re so naughty, onii-chan...
: But if it makes you feel any better...
: I had a dream like that too...
: Okay, that’s enough. Noriko, get off the bed-
: Wait wait wait! We let Ami go the full ten minutes and she said some weird stuff too! You’re being biased toward your floor! I will not stand for it!
: Noriko, give him all you’ve got!
: You’re really okay with just sitting back and watching her say things like that?!
: It’s immoral and disgusting and-
: Onii-chan?...Why aren’t you saying anything?
: Is your mind wandering again?
: Yes. Right now, it’s somewhere between being under the influence and potentially ruining at least two different relationships before the first contest is over.
Noriko giggles and slides herself forward, lightly grinding her lower body against one of my legs...
Her voice gets quieter and more seductive.
And, in other news, I love the dorm war.
: You know, onii-chan...Mom and Dad aren’t home right now...
: So if you’re worried about ruining things with them...you don’t have to be...
: Besides, I see no harm in doing a little...experimenting with you...
: I’m at that age where I’ve been thinking about all sorts of naughty stuff...and I have no idea what I’m supposed to do about it...
: You’re smart...aren’t you, onii-chan?...
: Can you teach me how to relieve some of those strange urges I’ve been having?...
: Hey! What’s going on in there?! Why is the door locked?!
: Noriko, as much as I am enjoying this, we should probably-
: Do it quick? If that’s what you think is best, onii-chan...
: We can always wait for another day for you to...teach me things...
: For now...why not let your little sister help you out?...
: Noriko! Stop it right now!
: Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert...
: Ahh! My eyes!
: I’m not ready!
: Come on! You guys are really killing the mood right now!
: Right, onii-chan?!
: Tell them you want some private time with your little sister!
: I...uhhh...
: Could you two maybe leave the room for like, three minutes?
: Absolutely not! I’m unlocking the door and letting Ami back in.
: Noriko, get off of Sensei right now. This contest is officially over.
: What’s going on in there?!
: Uhh, nothing! Just some...wholesome brother and sister bonding!
: Noriko totally didn’t try to grab Sensei’s-
: Glasses! She tried to put his glasses on!
: And...as someone who understands the importance of...vision...I could not allow the contest to proceed!
: Oh. It sounded like something else happened, but I guess Noriko’s smart enough to know her place and not try anything she shouldn’t.
: I’m sorry, onii-chan...it looks like our parents came home earlier than expected...
: But feel free to dream about me again tonight, okay?
: Maybe I can give you another pair of my panties to help you out?
: Wha-
: Another?!
: I’m pretty sure it’s just roleplay again, but...
: She kinda drugged him. So I don’t think anything is off the table right now.
: So, uhh...that was definitely...one way for this competition to go.
: No matter what happens, I am satisfied with the result.
: Why did we even let this particular contest happen in the first place? Of course it was going to end like this...
: Next time you drug my [uncle], don’t lock me out of the room.
: Next time?
: Got it. We’ll share him if I do it again, like good little sisters should.
: Why is everyone except Makoto so accepting of this? You could have killed me.
: You look fine to me.
: And your glasses certainly felt fine, if you don’t mind me saying that.
: What does that even mean? Just hurry up and tell me I won so we can move onto the next contest.
: Agreed. It pains me to say this, but the sooner we name Ami the victor, the better.
: Hey, hold on a sec! Noriko may have played dirty, but she was still a great little sister!
: Just imagine wakin’ up to something like that! If you were a boy, you’d be over the moon!
: She literally drugged him. And we don’t even know what she gave him or where she got it from.
: Doesn’t matter. It’s over and done with. Just hurry up and pick a winner, onii-chan.
Ami wins
: Well, it probably comes as no surprise, but the winner of the apparent little sister contest is Ami.
: Hah! Of course it is.
: True love always prevails. But don’t get so down about it, Noriko. I’ve been practicing for this contest since the moment Sensei took me in.
: But...I’ve also been kind of like a little sister to you for basically forever.
: What did I do wrong?
: Noriko, you literally drugged me.
: Yeah, there was no way you were going to win after making a move like that.
: A real little sister thinks about her brother’s health before anything else.
: I wouldn’t have had to do that if I had gotten to go first! Just...waking him up was a part of my plan and I knew what I gave him was safe and...yeah.
: This isn’t over, though!
: Ami may have won the little sister contest, but it would have been completely different if we were fighting over who the better girlfriend would be!
: Noriko, I wouldn’t want a girlfriend to drug me either.
: I’ll remember that!
Noriko wins
: The winner of the apparent little sister contest or whatever this was called...is Noriko.
: What?
: Hell yeah!
: Hell yeah!
: Are...you fucking insane?
: Are you really just overlooking what she did?
: No. What she did was inexcusable and it’s a miracle she won with that in mind.
: Hey, what kind of victory speech is this? I want to be praised and stuff.
: The reason Noriko wins is that she just felt like a more authentic little sister to me.
: That was your idea of authentic? Roleplay like that is arguably the least authentic thing that exists.
: It was certainly...a thing. Though, I definitely enjoyed it.
: Same. I would have kept going if we weren’t stopped, too.
: The thing is, Ami’s portion of the contest was just more of...Ami being Ami.
: But...
: But you love me...
: Obviously. But to me, it was like you were just being my [niece] like always and slapping an “onii-chan” sticker on it.
: But...I had a whole backstory...
: True, but Noriko actually felt like a different person.
: So...I lost because...I’m too good at being your [niece] to be seen as anything else?
: If that’s how you want to rationalize it, sure.
: You were both great, though.
: Well...it feels a little better when you put it like that...but I still don’t like this...
: I wouldn’t worry, Ami. Sensei’s probably always looked at me like a little sister anyway, so my portion of the contest was probably just him living out some fantasy of his.
: You know, I can’t say there are any fantasies of mine that involve being drugged.
: I’m sure there will be at least one after this morning, though.
: Let’s just...stop talking about this contest altogether and move on...
: I absolutely can not be the only person extremely uncomfortable right now.
: For once, I actually agree with Makoto.
: Let’s just get dressed and...walk to the park...
Makoto and Uta head out before the rest of us so they can relay the results of the match to their teams.
I’m ready before Ami and Noriko are, but I still decide to wait for them near the front door so we can all walk to the park together.
I’m sure it would be significantly more awkward if it were just the two of them, so I’m hoping my presence is able to quell some of the unease.
It’s not really easy to just choose between two girls you like, especially when you know how sensitive both of them are.
But it’s still just a game at the end of the day. And I’m sure that the result of this match won’t have any long lasting effects on their relationship.
Or my relationship with them, for that matter.
They’ll both continue to be head over heels in love with me-
And I will continue to absorb their feelings until there is nothing left of them.
